dense_claim_boundary: memory-pressure intervention; not a guaranteed hardware cache flush
sparse_claim_boundary: page-footprint-oriented control; does not fully exclude TLB effects

states.DENSE_MEMORY_PRESSURE: two target warmups, synchronize, buffer.sum(), synchronize, target
states.SPARSE_PAGE_PRESSURE: two target warmups, synchronize, buffer[::1024].sum(), synchronize, target
states.WARM_RECOVERY: after DENSE, two target warmups, synchronize, target
